name: Foreman Oslow
summary: At Lakeshire, Foreman Oslow struggles to rebuild the Everstill Bridge. Blackrock orcs shattered the crossing, while lost tools and stolen supplies have stalled the work. He needs help recovering his equipment and gathering materials so the town can restore its trade route.

sections.title: A Town Cut in Two
sections.body: Foreman Oslow works beside the broken Everstill Bridge, trying to reconnect Lakeshire. The span crosses Lake Everstill, linking the western roads toward Elwynn with the eastern shore. Blackrock orcs came down from the crags of Stonewatch and struck the crossing to cripple Lakeshire's trade and military movement. With the bridge broken, the town is split and exposed.

sections.title: Sunken Steel and Stolen Stone
sections.body: Foreman Oslow has lost the tools and materials needed for repairs. After the bridge fell, replacement tools traveled overland from Goldshire, then went aboard a lake ferry. Blackrock orc catapults struck the vessel, sending Oslow's heavy iron toolbox to the muddy bed of Lake Everstill. Gnolls in Redridge also seized a caravan of new materials from Stormwind, taking the iron pikes and rivets needed to raise the arches.

faq.answer: Foreman Oslow is a human stonemason and builder in Lakeshire. He leads the work to maintain and rebuild the Everstill Bridge.

faq.q: Why is the Everstill Bridge broken?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs shattered the Everstill Bridge. Its destruction severed Lakeshire's main route, weakened the town's defenses, and cut easy travel between the eastern and western shores.
Oslow's heavy toolbox lies at the bottom of Lake Everstill. A Blackrock catapult barrage struck and sank the boat carrying it from Goldshire.

faq.q: Why hasn't the bridge been repaired yet?
faq.answer: Oslow cannot resume construction because Blackrock orc catapults sank his tools in the lake and gnolls stole building supplies from incoming shipments. He needs outside help to recover equipment and materials.

faq.q: Where did Oslow's supplies come from originally?
faq.answer: Oslow's replacement tools came by wagon from Goldshire in Elwynn Forest, then transferred to a lake ferry to bypass the broken bridge.

faq.q: What threats is Oslow dealing with?
faq.answer: Oslow faces Blackrock orcs in the nearby heights, whose siege engines bombard the lake, and prowling gnolls that attack supply convoys.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you know Lakeshire's broken bridge leaves the eastern frontier exposed. Restoring it is vital to securing the border.
As a miner, you know Oslow depends on raw materials, metalwork, and quarry shipments to rebuild the broken masonry.
